text:
alex: heads-up — seeing 95th+ token latency spike for requests routed from EU->US. tail token latency up ~120ms since the deploy. KV cache hit rate dropped from ~0.87 to ~0.63 for the affected routes. kernel selector appears to be falling back to the slower generic_FP32 path on longer contexts. anyone digging?
maria: thanks @alex. can you paste a sample request id + route? I’ll check the per-route / token-level panels in Grafana first.
alex: req id: req_20260304_9f3c, route=eu->us-west, model=redwood-open-7b, seq_len=1024. saw lots of tiny batches (1-2) and high queue wait for the tail tokens.
sam: noted. i ran a quick trace earlier — kv misses spiked when prefix cache TTL bumped and we hit a cold shard. flame summary below (short):
sam: ```flame: kernel_select -> attn_compute -> kv_lookup -> memcpy — tail path shows extra memcpy + kv lookup ~120ms```.
infra-bot: deploy bot: deployment/redwood-open-7b@2026-03-04T10:12:08 completed to eu-region. (CI:2314)
maria: two immediate hypotheses: (1) kernel headroom estimator is mis-classifying long sequences and forcing fallback kernels; (2) routing policy started sending ~12% eu traffic to us-west to absorb load — cross-region RTT adds ~40-80ms. both can amplify tail.
jin: can we get a token-position latency heatmap split by route and kernel tag? we need median/95/99 per-token position to see where tail grows.
lisa: +1 on heatmap. also we lack a failover/fallback-rate metric on the routing dashboard — we only have request counts. need a metric showing how often routing falls back to alternate region/model and why.
alex: suggested quick actions: 1) maria add Grafana panels: token-level latency by token_index + kernel_variant + route, and failover-rate timeseries; 2) sam run kernel-selection microbench across seq_len buckets (256/512/1024/2048) to map threshold behavior & upload results; 3) ops/infra temporarily bias routing to prefer intra-region until KV warmups complete. anyone object?
sam: ACK. will run microbench and attach CSV + short table of kernel decision thresholds. ETA ~2h.
maria: adding panels now — will also add an alert: cross-region token-95 > 100ms for 5m -> pager to infra. ETA EOD today.
alex: can someone also dump one full trace (kv logs + kernel tag) for that req id into the perf-bucket and post link here? will help correlate.
sam: uploading trace now -> gs://redwood-perf/traces/2026-03-04/req_9f3c.trace (perm: eng-infra).
maria: pulled trace, creating panel queries. rough query notes: aggregate by token_index, group_by kernel_variant, filter route=eu->us-west and route=eu->eu, compute pctile(50,95,99) and avg kv_hit.
jin: once panels live, can we add a small dashboard that shows routing decision matrix (region->region), with per-cell avg latency and failover rate? will help ops tune policy.
lisa: also add a short runbook blurb: if cross-region tail persists, rollback routing heuristic + increase KV prefix TTL to 30s while we warm cache.
alex: perfect. keep updates here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
